results.title: SKUAST-K, NIFT Sgr sign MoU to strengthen research, innovation
results.description: ‘MoU opens new avenues for wool, pashmina, silk value addition, research, design, entrepreneurship’ SRINAGAR: Sher-e-Kashmir University of Agricultural Sciences and Technology of Kashmir (SKUAST-K) and the National Institute of Fashion Technology (NIFT), Srinagar, have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) to strengthen collaborative research, innovation, product development and academic exchange, with a special focus on [...]
